messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break (holiday + weekend).  

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Weekend Days Included | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-----------------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (observed in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, and some other provinces) | Fri Feb 17 – Sun Feb 19 | 3‑day break (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 | 3‑day break (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Fri May 20 – Sun May 22 | 3‑day break (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **Mar 17** | St. Patrick’s Day (statutory holiday in Newfoundland & Labrador) | Fri Mar 17 – Sun Mar 19 | 3‑day break (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Fri Sep 1 – Sun Sep 3 | 3‑day break (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Fri Oct 6 – Sun Oct 8 | 3‑day break (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day (observed in most provinces) | Fri Nov 10 – Sun Nov 12 | 3‑day break (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Fri Dec 22 – Sun Dec 24 | 3‑day break (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |

### Quick‑reference JSON (useful for API integration)

```json
[
  { "date": "2023-02-20", "holiday": "Family Day", "province": "AB, BC, SK, ON, etc." },
  { "date": "2023-04-07", "holiday": "Good Friday" },
  { "date": "2023-05-22", "holiday": "Victoria Day" },
  { "date": "2023-03-17", "holiday": "St. Patrick’s Day", "province": "NL" },
  { "date": "2023-09-04", "holiday": "Labour Day" },
  { "date": "2023-10-09", "holiday": "Thanksgiving" },
  { "date": "2023-11-11", "holiday": "Remembrance Day" },
  { "date": "2023-12-25", "holiday": "Christmas Day" }
]
```

> **Tip for your app** – If you need province‑specific long weekends (e.g., “St. Patrick’s Day” only in NL), you can filter the JSON by the `province` field.  
> For a fully up‑to‑date list, consider using the official Canada.ca public holiday API or the “Public Holidays Canada” dataset available on GitHub.
